members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2514: Request cancellation violates the MCP spec: cancel() was sending an incorrect error response instead of a notifications/cancelled message. Both PRs modify the same cancel() method — #2493 removes the wrong error response (citing spec: 'receivers must not send a response for a cancelled request'), and #2514 adds the spec-correct CancelledNotification in its place. Neither is complete without the other; they are sequential halves of the same fix.
